Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
Hey, can I ask you something？
What？
Are you sure... it's me you want？
Eh!?
Sometimes I get anxious. Why me, what part of me did you fall for...
...Maybe there's someone more wonderful for you...
Stop.
No imagining things that ignore how I feel！
Ah... You're right... I'm sorry.
(Hmm. How can I get ▲高嶺＊＊▲ to understand？)
▲高嶺＊＊▲. About what we talked about the other day.
Takane
...Yeah.
Why me, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ What part of me did you fall for？ I'm sure there were cooler guys.
N-No one could ever replace you...！
I see, that's a relief. Same as me.
...Huh.
It's not about which part I like. If I had to say... everything？
See, same, right？
...It's not the same at all...
I definitely love you more. ...I won't lose.
All right, it's a contest from here on, then？
Takane
Have you ever thought about how falling in love works？
Hmm, with ▲高嶺＊＊▲, I just fell for you before I knew it... That's why I said yes when you confessed.
I was so happy. But even so, I think there must be things about me that bother you.
Oh, no. I don't mean I'm unhappy or anxious about it...
Loving someone, including all those parts... Where does a feeling like that come from, I wonder.
Me too. I've never thought I hated anyone, but I've never loved anyone this much either.
So it's so mysterious. What does it mean, to fall in love with someone？
(It really is mysterious...)
Takane
Remember I said I was thinking about how falling in love works？
Yeah. Reach a conclusion？
Mm... No matter how much I think, I can't figure it out...
And then I suddenly remembered the saying that love isn't about logic.
When I remembered it, I felt better. ...Maybe I don't need to think about it anymore.
I see.
Yes. I'm sure you could come up with all kinds of logic, but it's fine.
Meeting you. I think that's the answer.
...Just saying.
Hehe, that's all from me. Ah, I thought so much I fell behind on studying, so I have to work hard from tonight！
Takane
Your birthday's coming up soon, isn't it？
Oh, is it that time already？
It's that time. Geez... Are all boys like that？
Like what？
Not that interested. In their own birthday.
Who knows. What about ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. I get all fidgety？
Getting older means gaining experience, right？
Thinking about how I'll spend the next year and who I'll meet makes it even more so.
I see. Deep stuff, birthdays...
Hey, how did this turn into talk about me？ We were talking about your birthday！
Takane
Hey, about your birthday...
...Geez. You forgot.
Hahaha... Well, you know. I'm more focused on ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday...
Really？
Well, of course. I'm already thinking about all sorts of things, believe it or not.
...Hmm.
"Hmm"... That's it？
W-What do you mean, "that's it"？
Oh, you're blushing.
...I am not. Right now we're talking about you, not me, right？ Geez！
(Could she be planning something？)
Takane
Sigh...
What？ About my birthday？
Hmm？ So you remembered？
O-Of course I remembered.
...Hehe, geez. You can keep forgetting, you know？ It's enough if only I know.
I guess that's true.
You agree, huh. Geez, you're... Hehehe！
By the way, you've been thinking about it a lot. Is there something？
Wouldn't it be nice if there were？
There isn't!?
Oh？ I thought you weren't interested？ Hehehe.
(Ugh, is she teasing me？)
...Hey, about my birthday.
Takane
Hmm. Finally interested, are we？
It's not like I wasn't.
Okay, okay. Yes, you can assume there's something？ But don't get your hopes up.
No, I'll get my hopes up.
Hehe, why？
Because you've been thinking about it all this time, right？ More than me.
...Because it's the day you were born. I want to say thank you, don't I？
Just kidding. I'll say happy birthday properly on the day, so wait for it？
It's almost ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday, huh？
Takane
Oh, you remembered？
Of course. Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family do anything？
Yes. We always celebrate everyone's birthday.
Don't tell me, a homemade cake too？
Yes. The Takane rule is that everyone except the birthday person makes it.
...So your dad joins in too？
Of course. He gets really fired up. Every year he takes the day off work.
That far!?
Hehe. Papa gets really into things.
I wonder what kind of cake he'll make this year... I can't wait▼
(If I don't try hard, my celebration will get overshadowed...！)
Takane
By the way, this year Papa says he's making something I've never tasted before.
O-Oh yeah... What kind of cake？
He won't tell me.
All I know is he had a friend in France send him the recipe specially.
France!?
Yes. I'm happy, but when I told him he didn't have to go that far, he said he can't lose.
...Can't lose to what？
He wouldn't tell me that either. Mama just laughed like, "Oh, that man."
But what kind of cake will it be... I can't wait▼
(Can't lose to... Could it be...)
How's your dad doing since then？
Takane
He practiced once. But Mama says it's hard and he's struggling.
I see...
And then he asked about you.
Huh... Me？
Yes. Whether we talk about my birthday, whether you said anything...
When I asked why he wanted to know, he said it's intelligence gathering.
...What！！
I didn't really get what he meant... Do you？
(So I'm his rival after all！)
Your birthday's right around the corner, huh？
Takane
Yes. I think this year will be special.
Special？
Yes. It's not often I talk about my birthday this far in advance, right？
And you care about it this much too. That alone fills me up.
That's a problem.
Huh？
You have to look forward to it at least a little. That gets me more fired up too.
Hmm？ So I'm allowed to.
S-Sure.
Hehe！ Then I'll take you up on that. Do your best, okay？
(I can't lose to her dad！)
Takane
It's almost been a year, hasn't it？
Oh, right. Already？
...Hmm, so you knew right away？
Ah. You were testing me？
Hehe, sorry. I didn't mean to be mean.
It went by in a flash, didn't it？ Since we started going out...
Remembering when I confessed... makes me embarrassed.
Remembering it makes me happy. Back then, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Geez, don't say it. ...Please, don't look at me either.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ hasn't changed one bit there.)
Takane
Hey, do people usually do something at milestones like this？
Ah, for anniversaries？
Yes. It's my first time, so I don't really know...
Hmm... I wonder？
Does talking like this count as doing something？
Hahaha, true.
Well, we don't have to think so hard about it, right？ If that's all we focus on, it'll feel cramped.
Hehe, because every day would become an anniversary？
Exactly. But the first year is special, right？
Yes. I'm sure no matter how many years go by, I'll remember that day...
Takane
Hey, how about we use this chance to tell each other something we'd like fixed？
Something to fix, huh...
...Nothing？
Hmm. What about ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Me？ Yes, nothing in particular, I guess？
Me neither.
...Hehe. That ended the conversation, didn't it？
Haha, well, I guess it means let's keep this up？
Okay▼
Takane
Hehe, it's almost here, huh？
Yeah. Thanks for this past year.
Oh, no, thank you too.
...Hehe.
Hahaha...
...I hope we keep having conversations like this forever.
The goal for now is three years？
No, five！
No way, ten！
Hehe, longer！
Haha, right！ Here's to us？
Yes▼
Takane
...Can I ask you something？
Sure, what？
Well？ ...Is it okay for me to be the one by your side？
Eh!?
I'm sorry！
I feel so happy. But...
I also feel anxious, like is it okay that I'm the only one this lucky...
This is my first time, so I don't know what to do...
...I'm sorry. I'll stop there.
(How can I make sure she gets how I feel...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲. About your question the other day.
Takane
Am I really okay as the one by ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s side？
Of course you are！
You're the one I want by my side... No, if it's not you, I...！
I see. Then we're the same. What a relief！
...Huh.
Are you sure？ Me？
I want ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Come on, come here.
...Okay！
Takane
How can a person love one person this much？
Hm？
I think about it a lot lately. What does "special" even mean？
I never thought about liking or disliking people. I liked everyone, everyone was important...
I always thought that way, but now...
You never know what'll happen to you, do you？
But really, why do I feel this way... It's mysterious.
(Yeah, why is that...)
Takane
Remember we talked about how a person can love one person so much？
Yeah, figure anything out？
Yes. I think it's because it's you.
Me？
...Right. If it wasn't you... I wouldn't have been able to love someone this much, for sure.
My first love, falling for someone for the first time...
I'm glad my first boyfriend is you. Thank you for being by my side.
...Oh no. It's like I'm confessing all over again.
But it's how I really feel. Let me keep loving you forever, okay？
Takane
Hey. Your birthday's coming up soon, right？
Ah, now that you mention it...
Is there anything you want？
Something I want？ Hmm...
I'll ask again, so think about it？ ...Oh.
Hm？
With things like this, is it more fun to keep it a secret？
Could be.
Right？ But I want you to be happy...
Hmm, what should I do. Um, um...
Decided which way？ Whether to hear my request or not.
Takane
No, not yet... Can I have a little more time？
Sure. I'll think it over carefully too, then.
Hey, can I just get a hint？ Like, your tastes.
Hmm... I feel like I'd guess what I'm getting, and it'd be less fun for me.
...Yes, maybe.
I'll decide about hints after I decide which way, then？
Like, chopstick rests, things like that？ And dolls are probably no good... right？ Hey, am I close？
(That's not really a hint anymore...)
So. The day's getting closer and closer...
Takane
Um...
Hahaha. It's fine, I'm not in a hurry.
Actually, you don't have to worry about it so much.
That's no good.
Because it's the important day you were born into this world.
I want you to be even a little happy... Is that a bother？
No, not at all. Thanks.
...No. I was worried it was just for my own satisfaction... so I'm relieved you said that.
I'll think it through, so wait a little longer？
Okay, got it！
Takane
I've decided.
Oh. Time for the announcement？
Hehe. I'm keeping it a secret after all.
I see. Okay, I'll look forward to it.
But don't expect too much, okay？
Awww？
Oh... Um, I do mean to try hard, but...
Hahaha, just kidding. As long as I'm with ▲高嶺＊＊▲, that's all I need.
...Th-Thank you...
Oh. You don't have to make me happy like that right now, okay？ I'm happy, but no fair？
(This alone is plenty for me！)
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday is almost here, huh.
Takane
Yes. Thank you for remembering.
Are they starting to talk about it at home？
Not yet. Hehe, it's too early.
Hahaha, I see.
But we make a cake every year, so maybe they're talking about that？
Don't tell me ▲高嶺＊＊▲ bakes her own birthday cake？
No. On that day, Papa makes it for me.
Huh, so that's how it's split up.
Yes. It's nerve-racking every time, hehe.
(Hm？ Is he not very good？)
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family throw a big birthday party？
Takane
Not big, exactly, but we do it properly？
Like I said before, we make a cake, sing "Happy Birthday," and exchange presents.
Then we eat a slightly fancier dinner than usual and reminisce.
Reminisce？
Yes. Stories from when I was in grade school, or when Papa and Mama were young.
Huh... Sounds fun.
Hehe. My birthday's the one night I get to stay up a little late.
I hope I can stay awake longer than last year.
Like, 9:30？
...I can stay up a little longer than that. ...Probably.
(But that's probably her limit...)
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. There was something I wanted to ask.
Takane
Yes, what is it？
Any requests？ Something you want, somewhere you want to go？
Hmm... Not really.
Ugh. Nothing？
Yes. If you just say happy birthday, that's enough.
I'll say that, of course.
Hehe. Just being celebrated makes me happy, so really, don't worry？ Thank you for thinking of it.
(Hmm... What should I do...)
Takane
About the birthday request you asked about the other day...
Oh！ Thought of something？
Yes. ...You.
Ah, then... Wait, what!?
The right to stay by your side for the next year. And it renews every year. Is that no good？
...That surprised me. It's not no good... but is that really all？
What do you mean, "all"？
Well, the seat next to me is already ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s. It's reserved.
Those words alone are plenty for me. Thank you for making me this happy even before my birthday.
I'll look forward to it every year, okay？
It's almost a year, huh...
Takane
Hm？ What？
You know, since we started going out.
...Yes. It feels like it went by so fast.
At first, I wondered what things would be like after a year, but...
Not much has changed？
Hm？
No. You're beside me. We're talking like this...
I just think that's amazing. Yes.
(That pause just now bugs me a little...)
Hey, you said the other day you wondered what things would be like after a year, right？
Takane
...Yes.
Weren't you thinking something after that？
...Hehe. I can't hide anything from you...
To be honest... back then, I thought that a year later, I might not be by your side.
Eh!?
I couldn't believe in myself. ...Was it really okay to be this happy...
...So I thought things like that...
Oh, but I'm okay now？ You've said so many things to me... I've gained a little confidence.
So don't worry？ ...Sorry for saying something weird.
(Just "a little"...)
Is there anything ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wants me to fix？
Takane
Hehe, what's this all of a sudden？
Well, it's our first anniversary, so let's be clear about it.
Hmm... Not really？
Really？
...Yes.
No, there is something！
What！ ...Hey, it was like this last time too... How can you tell？
Well, I am your boyfriend.
...Yes, I see...
I feel like I could get really confident...
(Yep, a good sign！)
Our first anniversary's right around the corner, huh？
Takane
Yes. Thank you for this year. You know, I...
Hm？
Can I stay by your side like this next year too？ ...Oh.
No, I want to be by your side even after that. So... here's to us, okay？
Sure. Here's to us, too.
Yes▼
Takane
Hey, a question.
Hm？ What？
...Do you regret making me your girlfriend？
Why so suddenly... Did I do something？
No, it's not that. It's just...
It's just, I think I don't have confidence...
...Wanting you to make up for my own shortcomings... I still need to work harder.
I'm sorry. Pretend you didn't hear that？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ should be more confident...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲. I have never once regretted that ▲高嶺＊＊▲ became my girlfriend.
Takane
W-What？ All of a sudden...
If anything, am I okay？ As the boyfriend you chose？
N-No one but you... I've never even considered it.
Yeah, me too. So let's both be confident from here on. Confirming our feelings like this.
...I can be confident？
Of course！ In exchange, help me get confident too？
Hehe... Geez... You can be full of confidence, you know？
Then ▲高嶺＊＊▲ should be too. Otherwise it's unfair.
Hehehe！ Understood. ...Here's to us from now on, okay？
Takane
Do you know how falling in love works？
How it works？
Yes. It's all because of chemicals in the brain. Your heart pounding, feeling happy, all of it.
That's kind of blunt...
Right？ It's so scientific, I was a little disappointed.
Even more when I think that us being like this is thanks to adrenaline or endorphins.
Hmm... But is that really true？
Really？
I mean, do people fall in love just from that？
...I wonder. I hope it's not just that, but...
Takane
You know？ I've decided to stop thinking about it.
Hm？ ...Oh, how falling in love works？
Yes. Even if it's just brain chemicals acting on a whim... I think it only would have happened in front of you.
...I met you, and I fell in love with you. I think that's all I need.
Besides, isn't it frustrating？ I don't want this much love for you explained away as science.
Yeah, I see your point.
Hehe, right？
I'm sure I'll keep loving you more and more from now on... You'll take it all, okay？
Sure, leave it to me！
Takane
Hey, it's a little early, but... your birthday's coming up, isn't it？
Ah！ Mine？
Hehe, yes. Yours, nobody else's.
I see, one step closer to being a grown-up.
To mark it, is there anything you want, any requests？
From ▲高嶺＊＊▲ to me？ Let's see...
It doesn't have to be right now, so will you think about it？
Sure, got it. But why do you look so happy？
Because it's the day you were born, you know？ I get to celebrate it, so how could I not be happy？
Oh, you're blushing？ Cute▼
(Anyone would, if you said that to their face...)
Takane
Hey, did you think of it？ Your request.
Not yet. I'm torn on a lot of things.
Hmm, ponder away. That's the privilege of youth.
Hahaha. Hey, on the flip side, is there something ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wants to give me？
Hmm？
Oh. There is.
I won't say there isn't. But still, I want to give you something you want.
I see...
And I'm curious what you'll pick. Hehe, can't wait▼
(D-Did the bar just get higher... Or is it just me？)
(Come to think of it, I still haven't thought of a birthday request...)
Takane
Hey, you.
Huh!?
Hehe, it's written all over your face. You haven't decided yet, right？
No...
Geez. I didn't mean to make you worry this much... Hey, can you leave the rest to me？
In exchange... don't brood over it so much alone.
Ah... You're right.
No, it was my fault too. I wanted to celebrate, and I made you worry.
(I ended up making her worry instead... I'll be careful.)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, how's it going？ Is my birthday plan coming along？
Takane
...Geez. You're totally different from the other day.
Hahaha. Well, you know.
Hehe, okay, okay. It's coming along？ Look forward to it？
Oh, confident？
...Yes. Because the person happiest about your birthday is surely me.
More than me？
Yes. So I'm confident I can make you smile. ...Just saying.
Oh, and I'm saying happy birthday first, so if someone's about to say it, run away, okay？ At full speed！
...I'll do what I can.
No, please do it.
Haha, roger！
Good. Just kidding！ Hehehe！
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday is coming up soon...
Takane
Hmm, you remembered？
Of course.
Hehe, thank you. Are you maybe planning something？
Yeah, kind of. By the way, does your family do anything？
Yes. It's firmly built into the yearly schedule.
I see. ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family seems really proper about that.
If anyone forgot, there'd be trouble？
So you too... Oh, but since you're bringing it up this early, you'll be fine？
Hmm... I plan to be, anyway...
Teeheehee！
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What's the present that made you happiest so far？
Takane
The best was a fountain pen, I think？ A gift from Papa and Mama when I started middle school.
Huh... Why a fountain pen？
Mama always used one？ She looked so lovely using it that I secretly tried it.
And it was so nice to write with. I used it every day, so I got caught right away.
...Writing until I crushed the nib was no good, was it.
Hahaha, that's so ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
So they gave me one at my entrance ceremony. But it's too precious, so I don't use it.
Not using it seems more of a waste...
Yes, I know. So？ Was that helpful？
Hehe！ Do your best, okay？
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ ever hate birthdays？
Takane
Why？
I hear it sometimes. Girls talking about it with gloomy faces.
Hehe, yes, there might be some. For me, it's fun and I'm happy, but...
Oh, and it helps me refocus.
Refocus？
Yes. Getting older isn't the only part of growing up, right？ I want to really grow each year, don't you？
I see.
That got a little serious. Yes, but that's how I feel, I guess？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ really does think things through...)
One way or another, ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday is almost here...
Takane
Yes. Hey, remember I said birthdays help me refocus？
Ah, yeah.
But this year... I'm not thinking about that much.
Huh... Why？
Because you're here with me. That alone makes my heart pound.
I think it'll be a special day I won't forget no matter how many years pass.
...Hehe！ So come be the first to say happy birthday, okay？ I'll be waiting.
Sure！
Takane
Since then... since the day I confessed to you, it's almost a year.
Right... Yeah, it was around this time.
It feels like "already," and it feels like "only"... Time is strange.
Yeah.
Hehe. A lot happened this year, didn't it？
Yeah, more than I can count on both hands.
Hey, if the first year was like this, what'll the second and third be like？
Oh, it'll be wild. Ready？
Hehe, of course. Let's keep making lots of memories, okay？
Takane
Hey, am I... growing properly as your girlfriend？
I'd say you're perfect, no？
...You answered instantly. Is that true？
It's true. For instance, things only a girlfriend can do, like this and that...
Huh!? W-What are you talking about？ Geez, in a place like this...
Going on dates, walking hand in hand, right？
▲Takane＊＊▲？
Geez... Hmph！
(...Why is she mad？)
About what we were talking about the other day.
Takane
Oh. You're going to say something weird again, aren't you？
I-I won't. I was wondering if I'm growing as ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s boyfriend.
...Why'd you go quiet？
Hehe, kidding. I think you're too good a boyfriend for me？
If you'd stop saying things like last time, you'd be even better... But that's part of you too, right？
Please stay just as you are▼
(I can just be happy about that... right？)
Takane
The countdown to our first anniversary has begun▼
It has.
Hehe. They say it's tempting fate to talk about next year, but...
Next year, and after that, I hope we can spend our time like this？
Yeah. Both growing as we go.
Yes. Piling up all sorts of things, one by one... Aiming to be a sweet old couple？
That's a long way off.
It is a long way off.
Hahaha...
Hehehe...
